text_block_list.text:
After putting on a stunning performance in 
the Wakagoma Stakes, Tokai Teio gleefully 
noted, "I stood out pretty well!"

Having finished warming up, she sets her 
sights on the first leg of the Classic 
races to decide the top of her 
generation—the Satsuki Sho!

Tokai Teio's challenge to match the 
magnificent record left behind by Symboli 
Rudolf—a Triple Crown sweep—begins right 
now!
